reference_sql:
SELECT MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date,
       MAX(order_date) AS last_order_date,
       MAX(units) AS max_units,
       MAX(net_revenue_eur) AS max_line_revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE store_code IN ('BE-01', 'LU-01')
  AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
